TOURNAMENT SESSION & DRAFTING ROLES

Enforce role-based drafting permissions • Prevent unauthorized team bans
1 ACTIVE TOURNAMENT SESSION
Live peer-to-peer scrim sessions synchronize bans, flagships, and match timers across all 20 players without a central server.
2 PARTICIPANT ROLE & AUTHORITY STATUS
🛡️
TOURNAMENT REFEREE / HOST (CAPTAIN A)
Primary session coordinator. Can ban for either team, set flagships, adjust fleet comps, and manage match clocks.
FULL ACCESS
🔷
TEAM A CAPTAIN (BLUE FLEET)
Can only draft bans on Team A's turns (Turns 1, 4, 5). Can designate Team A flagship and edit Team A fleet comp. Cannot edit Team B.
TEAM A DRAFTER ONLY
🔶
TEAM B CAPTAIN (CO-HOST)
Secondary session coordinator. Can draft Team B bans, designate Team B flagship, concede Team B, and failover if Host drops.
TEAM B DRAFTER / CO-HOST
🧹
ARENA RING CLEANER
Arena grid maintenance duty (clearing wrecks, canisters & drones). Receives synchronized match clock & popout HUD.
GRID CLEANER
👁️
SPECTATOR / OBSERVER
Read-only observation mode for coaches, casters, and scouts. Real-time bans, fleet comps, and synchronized clock.
READ ONLY
